props.covers: The durable SyncState shape, status vocabulary, and coexistence invariants for one sync workflow.

text.insert: SyncState is the durable state for one Sync workflow inside HarnessState. It carries observed intake, isolated staging progress, PR-series reconciliation, blockers, lineage, and the accepted publication boundary without duplicating the process algorithm.

props.description: Sync workflow: intake identity, staging progress, PR-branch reconciliation, and the atomic publication record.

fields.name: intake
fields.description: What this sync ingests. Captured when the operator starts sync.

fields.name: upstream_from
fields.description: Cycle head's upstream anchor before sync.

fields.name: upstream_to
fields.description: Observed upstream target. Equals upstream_from on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: corpus_batch_ids
fields.description: Staged corpora awaiting publication. Discord ids use discord-<hash> identities planned incrementally and frozen during observation.

fields.name: knowledge_only
fields.description: True when upstream did not move; reconciliation is skipped and only the knowledge revision advances.

fields.name: staging
fields.description: Isolated workspace where all reconciliation happens; null on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: pr_reconciliation
fields.description: One entry per open PR series rebased alongside the cycle.

fields.name: pushed
fields.description: True once the reconciled branch is pushed to its upstream PR at publish.

fields.name: publication
fields.description: Set by the atomic publish step; null until then.

fields.name: remote_application_id
fields.description: Boundary recorded in the cycle timeline; absent on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: invalidated_ids
fields.description: Targets, checkpoints, and PR snapshots explicitly invalidated by the boundary.

props.name: SyncState

text.insert: The shape keeps recovery decisions explicit: staging and per-series outcomes identify resumable work, blockers explain required intervention, and publication identifies the irreversible accepted boundary. A knowledge-only pass has no staging workspace and advances knowledge_revision without moving the cycle head.

props.title: Sync status semantics
rows: Intake is observed but not started.
No lease is held and no protected state changes.
Sync stages source and knowledge inputs.
Canonical source and knowledge truth remain unchanged.
Staging rebases cycle history and open PR series.
Publication cannot start without successful evidence.
Evidence is complete and awaits confirmation.
Confirmed records and branch updates are being committed.
Cancellation is unavailable; recovery moves forward.
The boundary and required pushes are durable.
Sync is terminal and releases authority.
Lease and recoverable state are preserved when active.
Staging is discarded and cycle current is unchanged.

text.insert: Status, staging, blockers, and publication must agree. validated is the operator gate; publishing permits only forward recovery; published requires a publication record; cancelled proves the canonical cycle remained untouched.
